name: AudioPlayer
description:
An audio player sharing the video player's core: seek bar with chapters, volume, speed,
loop, playlists, casting and the same shortcuts while focus is inside it. It sits in the
page; audio has no view modes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the player; defaults to the title.

props.name: attach
props.description: Connect a stream engine; see {@link MediaAttach}.

props.name: autoAdvance
props.description: Play the next entry when one ends. Default true.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Start as soon as the browser allows.

props.name: castAdapter
props.description: A casting session; see {@link CastAdapter}.

props.name: chapters
props.description: Named parts: marks on the seek bar and a menu.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only.

props.name: crossOrigin
props.description: For sources and tracks on another origin.

props.name: defaultLoop
props.description: Start repeating when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: defaultMuted
props.description: Start muted when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: defaultPlaybackRate
props.description: Default 1.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: The first entry when uncontrolled. Default: the first.

props.name: defaultVolume
props.description: Default 1.

props.name: labels

props.description: Wording overrides.

props.name: live
props.description: A live stream: the timeline shows the seekable window and go-to-live appears.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show the skeleton while the host loads what to play.

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: loop
props.description: Repeat the entry. Pair with `onLoopChange` to control it.

props.name: mediaSession
props.description: Publish to the operating system's media controls. Default true.

props.name: muted
props.description: Pair with `onMutedChange` to control it.

props.name: onEnded
props.description: Called when the entry ends.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called when playback fails, with what failed.

props.name: onLoopChange
props.description: Called when repeat turns on or off.

props.name: onMutedChange
props.description: Called when the player mutes or unmutes.

props.name: onPlaybackRateChange
props.description: Called when the speed changes.

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.description: Called with the id of the new entry and why it changed.

props.name: onVolumeChange
props.description: Called when the volume changes, from 0 to 1.

props.name: playbackRate
props.description: Pair with `onPlaybackRateChange` to control it.

props.name: playerRef
props.description: The player's controller, for commands from outside.

props.name: playlist
props.description: Entries to play in order, in place of `src`.

props.name: poster
props.description: The image shown before playback, or the artwork of audio.

props.name: preload
props.description: How much the browser loads up front. Default `metadata`.

props.name: rates
props.description: Speeds offered, ascending. Default 0.5 to 2.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The entry in play, by `id`. Pair with `onSelectedIdChange` to control it.

props.name: showPlaylist
props.description: Show the playlist's entries under the controls. Default true when there are several.

props.name: sources
props.description: Several encodings of the same media, best first.

props.name: src
props.description: One file. Use `sources` for several encodings.

props.name: stallAfter
props.description: Seconds playback may wait before the stall message shows. Default 8.

props.name: storyboard
props.description: A sprite sheet for the seek bar's preview.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A second line: the show, album or artist.

props.name: title
props.description: The name shown in the mini player, playlists and the system's media controls.

props.name: tracks
props.description: Caption and subtitle files.

props.name: volume
props.description: 0 to 1. Pair with `onVolumeChange` to control it.
